cards.name: The Shootout
cards.effect: Deal 2 damage to every enemy character here, then 1 damage to your strongest friendly character here. Enemy Protection and defenses apply.

cards.name: The Block Spin
cards.effect: On Reveal: Repeat every Hands reduction already dealt in this lane this round two more times on the same surviving characters still here. Repeated damage cannot repeat itself.

cards.name: The Setup
cards.effect: Sacrifice your weakest character here. Your strongest remaining character here inherits its current Hands plus 2. Requires two friendly characters.

cards.name: The Dice Game
cards.effect: On Reveal: Wager 1–3 Motion (both sides must afford it). Each side rolls three D6; add the highest two. Winner takes the pot, up to 9 Motion. Ties refund both wagers.

cards.name: The After Party
cards.effect: On Reveal: Extend this fight to 7 rounds. Additional After Parties do not extend it again.

cards.name: The Kickback
cards.effect: On Reveal: Move all characters on both sides into this lane. Locked cards and cards blocked by a lane lock stay.

cards.name: The Cookout
cards.effect: Deliver two Soul Food meals to occupied friendly districts, cleansing and granting +1 Hand to the weakest character in each chosen district. Leave a Burnt Plate: at this round end, give one local friendly character 1 Burn, then remove the plate.

cards.name: The Baby Shower
cards.effect: On Reveal: Give every friendly character here +1 Hand, then draw one card if your deck has any left.
